# Collect rows by reference
refs = {}
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    ref = ws[f"{col_ref}{r}"].value
    val = ws[f"{col_val}{r}"].value
    # Normalize numeric references if they are floats but represent integers

    if ref not in refs:
        refs[ref] = []

    others_sum = 0
    for _, v in occurrences[1:]:
        others_sum += (v if v is not None else 0)
